sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A governed system that connects information to its meaning and evidence.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Imagine a study notebook that can tell you which page supports each conclusion. The original books still matter.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A team wants to answer “What is Joule Studio?” using its own approved, accessible documents.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Source systems retain authority. Neo4j holds connected evidence and governed knowledge; SQLite holds operational records.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Finding text is insufficient when you also need its origin, history and permission boundaries.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Six stable contracts separate Source, Evidence, Knowledge, Governance, Retrieval and Action. This documentation is not the runtime system.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
